messages.message:
Patch Set 2:

(5 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The new family isn't exercised anywhere in the tree - nothing under lustre/utils or lustre/tests talks to it (lcfg_param_get_yaml() only resolves the "lustre" family, for devices/target_obd/stats), so the attribute layout has no coverage. Could this add a test that dumps the family and cross-checks the per-namespace values against the matching ldlm.namespaces.* parameters?

commit.subject: LU-19768 ldlm: add LDLM genetlink family
commit.message:
LU-19768 ldlm: add LDLM genetlink family

Add a new ldlm genetlink family that exposes per-namespace lock
statistics (contention, LRU, timeouts, and lock stats) via the
table-driven netlink framework introduced in the previous patches.
